subject: general
question: Which state in India has the largest scheduled tribe population as per the 2011 Census?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Madhya Pradesh** has the **largest population of Scheduled Tribes (STs)** in India as per the **2011 Census.**
 
• Approximately **21.1% of the state's total population** belongs to Scheduled Tribes.
 
• The major tribes in Madhya Pradesh include the **Gond, Bhil, Baiga, Korku, and Sahariya.**
 
• The state has a vast expanse of forests, hills, and natural resources</st
